name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_osteitis_deformans_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of Paget's Disease of Bone (osteitis deformans).
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of Paget's Disease of Bone (osteitis deformans).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of Paget's Disease of Bone (osteitis deformans).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of Paget's Disease of Bone (osteitis deformans).

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_osteitis_deformans_now@@confirmed_by_radiological_report
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current diagnosis of Paget's Disease of Bone (osteitis deformans) is confirmed by radiological report.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current diagnosis of Paget's Disease of Bone (osteitis deformans) is confirmed by radiological report.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current diagnosis of Paget's Disease of Bone (osteitis deformans) is not confirmed by radiological report.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the diagnosis is confirmed by radiological report.

name: patient_serum_alkaline_phosphatase_level_finding_value_recorded_now_withunit_u_per_l
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current serum alkaline phosphatase level in units per liter (U/L).
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if the patient's current serum alkaline phosphatase level (in U/L) is available.

name: patient_serum_alkaline_phosphatase_upper_limit_of_normal_now_withunit_u_per_l
meaning: Numeric value representing the current upper limit of normal for serum alkaline phosphatase in units per liter (U/L).
when_unknown: Set to null if the reference value is not available or indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the reference value for the upper limit of normal for serum alkaline phosphatase (in U/L) at the time of measurement.

name: patient_has_finding_of_hypersensitivity_to_active_substance_inthehistory

when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever had a hypersensitivity (adverse reaction) to the active substance.
